# hg expose

**What this page tells you:** every `hg expose` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Refresh or stop the auto-started local urls.

## Synopsis

```text
hg expose [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--stop` | — | — | Stop them instead. |
